steps: Mistique deduces that you're investigating the orphanage's debt after gathering clues for a couple of days. Intelligence from the anonymous tip reveals that the recipe is also connected to the orphanage.
Investigation on Golden Nightingale... Some people really have too much time on their hands, stirring up this nonsense at a time like this.
I've already warned them, but I doubt they'll back down so easily.
This is troublesome. I hope it won't interfere with our plans.
Heh, with the Tyrant involved, it's bound to mess things up.
Still, no need to worry too much—maybe they'll actually help us.
22:00, Tonitrua Month 31st, Greenhouse District in Philae, United Harvest Warehouse
Good work today, everyone.==W== That wraps up day one. How are you all holding up?
Research is way harder than I thought==W==...==W== Sorry for dragging everyone down.
Huh? Is the magic circle supposed to glow like that? Something feels ... off.
That is definitely not normal! And the alarm is deafening!
Hehe,==W== we gave it a few more tries,==W== and the magic flow has been smooth sailing ever since.
All that shouting...==W== It was terrifying==W==...
Hey, intern! Why so quiet?==W== This is a pep rally! Don't be shy—shout with the team! Let it out! Let me hear you! Come on, ready—!
I can't hear you! From the top! On my count: three, two, one, SHOUT!
Don't worry,==W== Amber.==W== I checked with a senior in Marketing. These pep rallies aren't daily.==W== We only have to do them twice a week==W==.
The Production Department was certainly interesting.==W== We witnessed quite the spectacle.
Kitty cat rolling, tumbling and playing!==W== Stretch your body,==W== up and away!
Dream big dreams, don't be shy! Kittens stay small, oh my, oh my! But the little green tree will reach the sky one day!
Mandrake Radiant Grass?==W== R&D told me about that!==W== Can't believe you beat me to the punch==W== and saw the real thing first!
Those plants are dangerous.==W== You can't exactly reason with them,==W== so things go south the second you let your guard down.
Lady Firenze actually went down to Production?==W== Well? Was her aura totally overwhelming?
Sapphire, Ruby. Is this what passes for "management" in Production these days?
It was intimidating.==W== Honestly, working under her watch felt twice as draining.
Ah,==W== haha, don't sweat it!==W== Lady Firenze is swamped.==W== She hardly ever sets foot in Production.
If you've got questions about the work, just ask Ruby or Sapphire.==W== They're both really nice.
She rarely shows up there...==W== Then did she come today specifically because we were starting?
Anyway,==W== we survived day one. Let's pool our intel.
I want to know everything that went down today.==W== Every. Last. Detail.
Me first, me first!==W== Okay, so this morning==W== at R&D—
Step one:==W== Greet people in the lab with "Good morning."
Uh,==W== but they're usually in a group...==W== Maybe==W== "Good morning, everyone"?
As for my expression...==W== Um,==W== a simple smile works, right?
A big grin like Noya's might be better,==W== but...==W== No, that's way,==W== way too hard.
After the greeting,==W== segue into the important stuff.==W== Like==W==...==W== "Those United Harvest mercenaries are cool!==W== What weapons do they use?"==W== No,==W== wait.==W== Too forced?
Nazuna was right.==W== If Fuyuka's missing,==W== check the hallway corners for a muttering white mushroom.
Lucky me—==W==I dug you up on the second try!
Nazuna senpai ...==W== knows me too well.
Uh...==W== R-Right.==W== I-I just ... needed a spot where n-no one could see me to, um,==W== mentally prepare myself for the greetings...
If you keep "preparing," there won't be anyone left to greet.==W== Because—
N-Noya!==W== You don't have to tell everyone that part!
Mistique said==W== she wanted every last detail.
That's right!==W== That's exactly the level of detail I need.
Heehee,==W== a clue to the Golden Nightingale could be hiding anywhere.
Is the Golden Nightingale==W== really all Mistique is after?==W== I get the feeling she has another agenda...
To save time, Amber, you handle the Marketing Department intel.==W== Text me what you and Iris found—==W==I'll process it while listening to Noya and Fuyuka.
You can handle two streams of intel==W== at once?
Not two—three.==W== I'll be drafting the Production Department piece at the same time.
I'll go whip up some late-night snacks.==W== Let's do this!
1:30, Calor Month 1st, Greenhouse District in Philae, United Harvest Warehouse
I'm wiped==W==...==W== I think I used up my entire word quota for the year tonight.
First time I've ever talked until my jaw quit working.==W== Seriously, Mistique, did you have to be that thorough?
Heehee! Day one, and we've already got a hundred pages of notes!==W== We're definitely inching closer to the Golden Nightingale's truth!
All that digging ... and we're only "inching closer"?==W== Sorting through a hundred pages is gonna take forever...
Great work, everyone.==W== Look at the time.==W== I'll handle the organizing. Go get some rest.
No, no, no.==W== You're resting too, Mina.==W== ==PLAYER_NAME== and I have got this covered.
Huh? Since when did I volunteer?!
But==W== I'm the one who hired you...
No "buts."==W== You've got to coordinate between departments tomorrow. Can't manage that sleep-deprived.
Besides, ==PLAYER_NAME== and I can just get the Radiant Grass to help with our grunt work in Production. Don't worry!
A-Alright then. Don't push yourselves too hard.==W== We won't uncover everything in one day, anyway. I'll be off now.
We're turning in.==W== Come back soon, and please, try not to overwork yourselves.
Heheh.==W== Well, look at that, Boss.==W== Now it's just the two of us left in the warehouse.
If you wanted a private word,==W== why force everyone to stall for hours until Mina left?==W== You could've just pulled me outside.
Oh, relax. Waiting for her to get out was part of it, sure.==W== But I truly wanted these records.==W== There's a delicious truth hiding in these pages.
Like how you didn't take Mina's commission for the money.==W== You took it to infiltrate United Harvest and find someone, right?
And that someone...==W== Let me guess.==W== The culprit who forced the Garden of Parasite into the Trekker Camp—
The proof's right here in the logs.==W== Remember what Fuyuka said earlier?
After the greeting,==W== segue into the important stuff.==W== Like==W==...==W== "Those United Harvest mercenaries are cool!==W== What weapons do they use?"==W== No,==W== wait.==W== Too forced?
Why ask about mercenaries if you're investigating the Golden Nightingale?==W== Those are Lady Gray's troops, aren't they?
You're a good person, Boss.==W== But I doubt your sense of justice is so strong that you'd infiltrate United Harvest just to catch her.==W== That's for the Philae Trekkers to handle.
Then it hit me.==W== When we first met, we talked about orphanages, didn't we?
Something trivial like "where the orphanage went." Folks in Flavio can dig that up in minutes.
So, the truth is obvious.==W== Lady Gray—==W==or rather, United Harvest—is connected to the orphanage.
Not bad. Exactly what I'd expect from Flavio's ace witch.==W== You pieced that together from scraps.==W== You're right. That was part of why we took the commission.
But==W== don't you think digging into people's secrets like this is dangerous?
Of course I do.==W== But I can't help myself.==W== The secrets you're hiding have such an alluring scent==W== that it's a risk I'm willing to take.
After all,==W== witches "feast on the truth."
Besides, I'm not taking your secrets for free.==W== I'll trade you my exclusive intel on the orphanage.
We are in "collaboration" now,==W== aren't we?
Amber? Sorry for the wait. You can come back.
Oh, no~==W== Did you guys hear everything?
Boss texted me==W== before we left.==W== Said the witch had something else to say.
My, oh my.==W== Was I that desperate to spill the beans?==W== Turns out I was the Boss's prey all along★
Well then,==W== feast your eyes on this.==W== Fresh, exclusive intel—hot off the press.
United Harvest didn't invent the Tawny Nightingale.
Two years ago, Firenze took the bread recipe from an orphanage in the Ash District of Emor.
Heartlink not established. Message failed to send.
They took it from an orphanage==W==?!
Back at the warehouse tonight,==W== I got a friend request sent by an anonymous user.
Heartlink contacts are added by tapping the phones,==W== and I hadn't checked my phone since I left this morning.
Which means==W== this "Anonymous User" tapped my phone today without me noticing.==W== They sent the request,==W== dropped the intel, then deleted me instantly.
As a witch, I've had my share of secret informants.==W== But this is the cleanest job I've ever seen. Didn't feel a thing, can't trace a thing either.==W== Whoever they are, they're a pro.
The only people close enough to tap Mistique's phone today ...==W== are the ones we met face-to-face.
Wait.==W== Forget the sender for a second. Look at the timeline we just uncovered...==W== It aligns too perfectly.
The orphanage, United Harvest,==W== Joseph in R&D,==W== Nyx in Marketing,==W== our interviewer Firenze,==W== CEO Darcia,==W== and Lady Gray in the shadows.
I get it now.==W== The Tawny Nightingale and the Golden Nightingale... They connect everything.
Everyone,==W== listen. Mina's commission, Lady Gray's location, the fate of the orphanage...==W== These aren't three separate mysteries.
They are a single, connected case.==W==
